name: Kanobare ~Kanojo ni Barezu ni Uwaki Shiro!~
original_name: カノバレ～彼女にバレずに浮気しろ！～
source:
I don't want my girlfriend to break up with me.....
But I want to cheat on her......
Then, I just have to 'cheat' without getting caught!!

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.UwakiEvasion]Google Play[/url]]
